tools.name: search_collection
tools.description: Semantic search across the collection, the same engine as the chat on nerdnoir.ai. Returns the closest notes with slug, title, a short excerpt, and the page URL, best first. Optional filters narrow by frontmatter. For a signed-in reader with workshop access, results can include slides from those wor

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Retrieve the full markdown body of a single note by its slug (e.g. "concepts/teaming/team-topologies"). Every published note is public.

tools.name: list_by_tag
tools.description: List every published note that carries a tag, with its slug, title, category, and excerpt. Use it to gather the notes on one theme when a note from search_collection or get_note shows a tag worth following, for example "team-topologies". The match ignores case.

tools.name: list_by_category
tools.description: Return all published notes in a given top-level category. Common categories: concepts, tools, resources, case-studies, sources, workshops.

tools.name: list_backlinks
tools.description: Return the set of notes that wikilink to the given slug. Useful for discovering related content and upstream references.

tools.name: tools_list_documents
tools.description: Return the tool documents the signed-in user owns or shares through a Space, most recently edited first, with each one's id, tool, version, role, Space, and url (the page that opens it in its builder). Pass toolKey to list one builder's documents. Every other document tool needs one of these ids.

tools.name: tools_get_document
tools.description: Return a document: its tool, title, version, url (the page that opens it in its builder), the current state as a projection with real ids, and the commands that tool takes. Read this before you change anything, and pass its version as expectedVersion on every write.

tools.name: tools_get_history
tools.description: Return the most recent events on a document, newest first, each with its event id and a plain description. Use an event id with a RestoreTo command to put the document back to the state right after that event.

tools.name: tools_export_document
tools.description: Export a document as a file. format "json" (the default) returns the snapshot the builder's Download JSON writes: the saved state, which the Scenarios Upload button imports as a new document, a summary, and the canonical entities (outcomes, with their kind, metrics, and bets) in one vocabulary acros

tools.name: tools_create_document
tools.description: Create a new, empty document for the signed-in user in one of the builders. Returns the new id and version. Pass spaceId to start it inside a shared Space the user can edit; without it the document is personal. Pass idempotencyKey and a repeat of the same call returns the document it already made ra

A later command may name an entity an earlier one created only if you supplied no ids; read the result for the ids it assigned. Pass the version from tools_get_document as expectedVersion. tools.name: spaces_list_spaces
tools.description: Return the user's Spaces with each one's id, kind (private, shared, or cohort: the Space of a workshop cohort the user is in), the user's role (owner, editor, or viewer), and how many notes, documents, and members it holds. Private comes first and belongs to the user alone.

tools.name: spaces_get_space
tools.description: Return one Space with its notes in order, its documents (each with the url that opens it in its builder), and its members with their roles. Private lists the documents the user keeps outside every Space. A cohort Space also lists its people: the cohort's members, by name.

tools.name: spaces_create_space
tools.description: Make a shared Space owned by the user, optionally with its first notes in order. Names are unique per owner.

tools.name: spaces_share_document
tools.description: Put a document in a Space so everyone in it can open it. Editors and the owner can change it; viewers read it. Name an existing spaceId, or newSpaceName to make one. Only the document owner may do this, and only into a Space where they are owner or editor. A document is in one Space at most, so this

tools.name: spaces_unshare_document
tools.description: Take a document out of its Space, so it is personal to its owner again. Only the document owner may do this; the Space itself is left alone.

tools.name: spaces_transfer_document
tools.description: Make another member of the document's Space the owner of the document. Use it when the reader asks to hand a document over, for example before they leave the Space. Only the current owner may do this, and the new owner must hold a role on the Space; a cohort reader does not count. Get the member's u

tools.name: spaces_invite_members
tools.description: Add up to 20 people to a Space with one role: editor (adds and changes things) or viewer (reads). Any email address works. Somebody with no account gets an invite email; somebody with one joins at once. Needs the owner or editor role. Returns one answer per address.

tools.name: spaces_remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member from a Space. Owner only. The person's documents in the Space pass to the Space owner, so nothing leaves the Space.

tools.name: spaces_leave_space
tools.description: Take the signed-in user out of a Space. Their documents in it pass to the Space owner. The owner cannot leave; they hand the Space over or delete it.

tools.name: spaces_add_note
tools.description: Add a published page to the end of a Space. Needs the owner or editor role. Adding a page that is there already changes nothing.

tools.name: spaces_remove_note
tools.description: Take a page out of a Space's list. The page stays published, and the Space keeps its other pages and documents. Use it when the reader asks to drop a page from a Space; spaces_get_space lists the slugs in it. Needs the owner or editor role.

tools.name: lil_nerdy_ask_question
tools.description: Ask Lil Nerdy, Nerd/Noir's own assistant, and get its answer with the collection pages it drew on. Use it when the user asks for Lil Nerdy, or for Nerd/Noir's judgment on their situation; for a plain lookup, search the collection yourself. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lil_nerdy_ask_question" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_collection, tools_list_documents, tools_get_document, spaces_get_space, lil_nerdy_ask_question · Private data: tools_list_documents, tools_get_document, tools_get_history, tools_export_document, tools_create_document, spaces_list_spaces, spaces_get_space, spaces_share_document, spaces_unshare_document, spaces_transfer_document, spaces_remove_member, spaces_leave_space, spaces_remove_note, lil_nerdy_ask_question · Public sink: tools_export_document, roadmap_apply_commands, roi_apply_commands, noice_apply_commands, ost_apply_commands, usm_apply_commands, vsm_apply_commands, cfd_apply_commands, wardley_apply_commands, spaces_share_document, spaces_invite_members · Destructive: tools_export_document, spaces_remove_member, spaces_leave_space, spaces_remove_note.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
